# Support

Use GitHub Issues for reproducible problems with the latest release or current source. Please include:

- Which app, version/build and source tag or commit you used.
- iPhone/iOS and Mac/Xcode versions.
- Source-build or downloaded-IPA route, plus any displayed error.
- The smallest steps that reproduce the problem and what you expected.
- A redacted screenshot or short diagnostic excerpt if it helps.

Do not include passwords, cookies, signing files, provisioning profiles, complete private logs, device IDs or private playlist/account details. [Security reports](../SECURITY.md) need a private route.

Website changes and catalog differences can affect compatibility. A skipped uncertain recording can be an intended result; include public recording/edition information only when you are comfortable sharing it. Do not rely on issue reports for urgent support or guaranteed response times.
